GMAL.Title: GM Asset Library
GMAL.NoAccess: The GM Asset Library is restricted to Game Masters in this world.
GMAL.NotReady: The GM Asset Library is still starting up. Try again in a moment.
GMAL.NoSharedEdit: Only users who can modify world settings can change shared collections, tags, aliases, notes and roles.

Open.Name: Open the GM Asset Library
Open.Hint: Opens or focuses the asset browser window.

Toolbar.Label: Asset library toolbar
Toolbar.ToggleDetails: Show or hide the details panel
Toolbar.Refresh: Rescan all sources (files, world documents, compendiums)
Toolbar.CancelIndex: Stop the running scan. Everything found so far is kept.

Search.Placeholder: Search names, paths, tags, notes… (type:image tag:undead -token)
Search.Label: Search assets

Status.Interrupted: Scan stopped early — results may be incomplete
Status.FromCache: File list from cache — press Refresh to rescan
Status.Truncated: File limit reached — raise it in the module settings or narrow the scan roots

Empty.IndexingHint: Results appear as soon as they are found.
Empty.NoCatalogHint: Press Refresh to scan the configured file roots, world documents and compendiums.
Empty.NoFavoritesHint: Click the star on any asset to keep it here.
Empty.EmptyCollectionHint: Select assets and use “Add to collection”, or drag them here from another view.
Empty.NoDuplicatesHint: Candidates are based on identical paths, filenames, or matching size and dimensions — never on image contents.
Empty.NoMissingHint: References outside the scanned roots are marked as unchecked rather than missing.
Empty.NoMatchesHint: Try fewer words, clear the filters, or widen the search scope.
Empty.NothingHint: This category has no assets in the indexed sources.

Filters.Title: Filters
Filters.DimensionsHint: Dimensions are read when an image is shown or selected; unmeasured images never match a dimension filter.

Details.Label: Asset details
Details.Title: Details
Details.Empty: Select an asset to see its details and actions.
Details.BulkHint: Actions below apply to every selected asset. Changes to campaign documents always ask for confirmation first.
Details.Name: Name
Details.NotChecked: Not checked yet — shown or selected files are verified automatically
Details.MissingFile: This file could not be loaded. It may have been moved, deleted, or you may lack access to it.
Details.MissingEntry: This entry is organized (favorite, collection, tag…) but no longer exists in the catalog.

Action.CopyFailed: Clipboard access was denied by the browser.
Action.MutatesHint: This action changes campaign data and will ask for confirmation.
Action.NotAvailable: That action is not available for the selected assets.
Action.DocumentNotFound: The document could not be loaded.
Action.NoPermission: You do not have permission to modify that document.
Action.NoControlledTokens: No controlled tokens that you can modify.
Action.ImportUnsupported: This compendium entry cannot be imported from here.

Confirm.ActivateScene: Activate the scene “{name}” for all players?
Confirm.SetToken: Replace the prototype token image of “{name}”? Existing tokens on scenes are not changed.
Confirm.ApplyTokens: Set the image of {count} controlled token(s) to “{path}”? Only the tokens on the current scene listed below are changed.
Confirm.CreateScene: Create a new scene with “{path}” as its background. The image is not modified.
Confirm.CreateSceneHint: The grid size below is a starting value. The module does not know the real grid of the map — adjust it in the scene configuration.
Confirm.CreateTile: Add a tile using “{path}” to the scene “{scene}”?
Confirm.SetBackground: Replace the background image of the scene “{name}”?
Confirm.AddSound: Add “{path}” to the playlist “{name}”? The sound is added stopped; nothing starts playing.
Confirm.Import: Import the {type} “{name}” from “{pack}” into this world? This creates a new world document.
Confirm.Forget: Remove favorites, tags, notes, aliases and collection memberships for {count} missing entr(y/ies)? Files and documents are not touched.

Scene.GridHint: Starting value only — the module does not infer the map's actual grid.

Playlist.NoAutoplay: The sound is added stopped. Nothing is played for your players.

Collections.Name: Collection name
Collections.DeleteConfirm: Delete the collection “{name}”? Its {count} asset(s) are not deleted; only the grouping disappears.

Alias.Hint: The file keeps its original name “{name}”. Leave empty to remove the alias.

Usages.Title: Used by {count} document(s)
Usages.None: No world document references this file within the searched scope.

Preview.GridOverlayHint: Overlay only — not the scene grid.
Preview.AudioLocalOnly: Preview playback is local to you and is never broadcast to players.
Preview.VideoMutedHint: Video previews start muted and never autoplay. Use the controls to play.
Preview.MediaDisabled: Audio and video previews are disabled in the module settings.
Preview.PdfHint: Displayed with your browser's PDF viewer.
Preview.NoVisual: This document has no image to preview.
Preview.ImageFailed: The image could not be loaded.
Preview.MediaFailed: The audio could not be loaded or decoded.
Preview.VideoFailed: The video could not be loaded or its codec is unsupported by this browser.
Preview.Unsupported: No preview is available for .{ext} files.

Reason.Missing: The file appears to be missing or inaccessible.
Reason.Remote: The file is hosted remotely; it may be blocked by CORS or network rules.
Reason.Unsupported: This format is not supported by the browser.
Reason.Unknown: The file exists in the index but could not be decoded. It may be corrupt, moved, or protected.

Diagnostics.Title: Asset Library Diagnostics
Diagnostics.CachesCleared: Thumbnail, metadata and catalog caches were cleared.
Diagnostics.NoCatalog: The catalog has not been built yet.
Diagnostics.NoExtensions: No other module has registered adapters or actions.

Availability.NoFilePermission: You lack the “Browse File Explorer” permission, so files cannot be listed.
Availability.NotReady: The game is not ready yet.

AccessPolicy.Name: Who can open the library (world)
AccessPolicy.Hint: GM only by default. Players never see documents or compendiums they cannot observe, and need Foundry's file browsing permission to see files.

FileRoots.Name: File roots to scan (world)
FileRoots.Hint: Comma separated, as source:path. Examples: data: (all user data), data:assets, data:worlds/my-world, public:icons, s3:bucket-folder. Only locations the File Picker can see are reachable.

ExcludedFolders.Name: Excluded folders (world)
ExcludedFolders.Hint: Comma separated folder names or paths skipped during the file scan. Default skips the modules and systems folders, which contain thousands of package files.

IncludeWorldDocuments.Name: Include world documents (world)
IncludeWorldDocuments.Hint: Catalog Actors, Items, Scenes, Journals, Playlists, Roll Tables, Cards and Macros of this world that the user can observe.

IncludeCompendiums.Name: Include compendiums (world)
IncludeCompendiums.Hint: Catalog the index of every compendium pack visible to the user. Only the lightweight index is loaded, never the full documents.

CompendiumTypes.Name: Compendium document types (world)
CompendiumTypes.Hint: Comma separated document types to index from compendiums.

MaxFiles.Name: Maximum files per scan (world)
MaxFiles.Hint: The scan stops when this many files were found and the status bar says so. Tested up to 50,000 synthetic entries.

ScanConcurrency.Name: Parallel directory requests (world)
ScanConcurrency.Hint: How many directory listings are requested from the server at once during a scan.

AutoIndex.Name: Rescan files every time the library opens (world)
AutoIndex.Hint: Off: the cached file list is shown instantly and documents are refreshed; press Refresh to rescan files. On: files are rescanned on every open.

MediaPreviews.Name: Allow audio and video previews (world)
MediaPreviews.Hint: Previews play locally in the viewer only and are never broadcast to players.

GenerateThumbnails.Name: Generate small thumbnails (world)
GenerateThumbnails.Hint: Downscaled thumbnails are generated once per client and cached in the browser (IndexedDB) so large images are not decoded repeatedly. Off: the original images are shown scaled down.

ProbeFileSizes.Name: Read file sizes (world)
ProbeFileSizes.Hint: Issues a lightweight HEAD request for files shown or selected to read their size and modification date. Remote (S3) files are not probed.

Debug.Name: Debug logging (world)
Debug.Hint: Write verbose diagnostics to the console.

ThumbnailSize.Name: Thumbnail size (personal)
ThumbnailSize.Hint: Width of grid thumbnails in pixels.

SearchScope.Name: Default search scope (personal)
SearchScope.Hint: Which sources global search covers by default.

ShowCardMeta.Name: Show metadata on grid cards (personal)
ShowCardMeta.Hint: Shows dimensions, duration and size under the name. Otherwise this information is in the details panel.
